name: fn_path_exists
description: Check whether a file or directory exists at the given path.

name: fn_is_file
description: Check whether the given path points to a regular file.

name: fn_is_directory
description: Check whether the given path points to a directory.

name: fn_is_readable
description: Check whether the current user can read the file or directory at the given path.

name: fn_is_writable
description: Check whether the current user can write to the file or directory at the given path.

name: fn_can_create_file_in_directory
description: Check whether the current user has write and execute permission on a directory, which is required to create files inside it.

name: fn_get_file_size
description: Return the size of a file in bytes.

name: fn_get_modified_time
description: Return the last modification time of a file or directory as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

name: fn_get_permissions
description: Return the permission string of a file or directory, for example 'rw-r--r--'.

name: fn_set_permissions
description: Set the permission mode of a file or directory using a numeric mode such as 420 (octal 644). Return true on success.

name: fn_read_text_file
description: Read the entire contents of a text file and return it as a string.

name: fn_write_text_file
description: Write text to a file. If append is true, add to the end of the file instead of overwriting it. Return true on success.

name: fn_create_directory
description: Create a directory. If parents is true, create any missing parent directories as well. Return true on success.

name: fn_delete_file
description: Delete a single file. Return true if the file was deleted.

name: fn_delete_directory
description: Delete a directory. If recursive is true, delete all of its contents as well; otherwise the directory must be empty. Return true on success.

name: fn_copy_file
description: Copy a file to a new location. If overwrite is false and the destination exists, the copy fails. Return true on success.

name: fn_move_path
description: Move or rename a file or directory to a new location. Return true on success.

name: fn_list_directory
description: List the entries in a directory that match a glob pattern (use '*' for all). Return the entry names as a single string separated by newline characters.

name: fn_count_files
description: Count the files in a directory. If recursive is true, include files in all subdirectories.

name: fn_get_file_extension
description: Return the extension of a file name including the leading dot, for example '.txt'. Return an empty string if there is none.

name: fn_join_paths
description: Join two path segments into a single path using the correct separator for the operating system.

name: fn_compute_file_hash
description: Compute the hexadecimal hash of a file using the given algorithm, such as 'md5', 'sha1', or 'sha256'.

name: fn_files_are_identical
description: Compare the contents of two files byte by byte and return true if they are identical.

name: fn_get_current_directory
description: Return the absolute path of the current working directory.

name: fn_change_directory
description: Change the current working directory. Return true on success.
